design_condition: Aligned parallel to the street and carefully staggered at the property corner, the building responds to neighboring residential forms, preserves the district scale, and creates varied outdoor play spaces.

positive.statement: The careful structure respects the district scale and produces well-proportioned interior conditions.
The project integrates into the existing building structure while clearly distinguishing the house as a public building.
The floor plan is well structured for operation and allows diverse, permeable, and flexible use.
The outdoor rooms are child-friendly, with varied play areas and plants for all seasons.
The direct access from the neighboring street is viewed positively and should be integrated further into operation.
The clear structure and construction grid offer good conditions for simple and economical construction.
The sustainable construction concept meets the requirements in an exemplary manner.

negative.statement: The facade is somewhat banal and lacks tension, with proportions and summer heat protection needing improvement.
The westward extension slightly exceeds the permitted maximum length.
The orientation deviates from the surrounding residential buildings and is irritating.
The street access is too small for waiting children and should be made more spacious.
The openness of the upper-floor gallery has not been fully resolved in fire-safety terms.
The outdoor space is not always visible from the classrooms and the play areas may be too small for the planned number of children.
The container and bicycle parking can only be implemented with an exceptional permit.
